footnotes.note: 1 Includes women with two injections during the pregnancy for the most recent live birth, or two or more injections (the last within 3 years of the most recent live birth), or three or more injections (the last within 5 years of the most recent live birth), or four or more injections (the last within 10 years of the most recent live birth), or five or more injections at any time prior to the most recent birth
2 Birth order refers to the order of the birth among the respondent's live births.

3 No education includes informal education (madrassa/duksi/adult education) and more than secondary includes middle-level colleges and universities. Secondary includes individuals who reported vocational training as the highest education level attended. Where a respondent's highest level attended is junior school, they are considered as having attained secondary level but not having completed it
